glamsterdam_bid_gossip.highlight: Two competing PRs for execution payload bid gossip: PR5774 (Potuz/Justin, proposer accepts any bid) vs PR5776 (Nico, 3% minimum increment with DOS protection)
Potuz opposes PR5776: prefers leaving gossip filtering to client implementations to avoid over-specifying; Prysm likely won't enforce it
PR5770: adds missing fork-choice checks to Gloas execution payload gossip validation; LGTM from Prysm/Teku; needs a few more client sign-offs before merge

glamsterdam_rollout.highlight: Consensus-specs release planned tomorrow (Oct 30); Lido PR is consensus-breaking and requires explicit devnet testing; devnet launch estimated Nov 16–20 at earliest

hegota_scoping.highlight: Proposed Hegota sequencing: launch with FOCIL + PeerDAS first, add smaller EIPs next, merge quick slots later in parallel
EIP-8015 (beacon state cleanup) SFI'd unanimously; already merged into Hegota spec and tested on devnet
CFI: EIP-8334 (Bundled Attestation Propagation) — simulation shows ~50% bandwidth reduction for home nodes under decoupled consensus load; purely networking change
CFI: EIP-8383 (Reduce CL Block Retention Window) — single config value change aligning blob/history retention windows; Lighthouse and Lodestar in favor
DFI: EIP-8205 (Withdrawal credentials preregistration / deposit front-running fix) — consensus to solve definitively with PQ deposit contract redesign instead
CFI: EIP-8148 (Custom sweep threshold for validators) — enables 32–2048 ETH range with configurable threshold; proof of concept in Prysm + DORA; Lido funding audit
CFI: EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast) — chunked payload propagation via gossip-sub; simulation shows 3× propagation improvement; Potuz suggested SFI immediately

eip_8365_hegota.highlight: EIP-8365 (remove 0x00 validator deposits): split between burning ETH (simpler) vs. Barnabas' proposal to re-queue balance as 0x01 deposit to avoid burn; deferred two weeks

focil_el_clarification.highlight: FOCIL Engine API ambiguity: some ELs rebuild payload entirely on inclusion list update at 6s, causing missed blocks; CL expects append-only; needs EL input — to be raised at next ACDE

organizational.highlight: Alex Stokes stepping down as ACDC moderator; Ben Edgington takes over as lead moderator, Will Kokorin as deputy, starting in two weeks

action_items.action: Client teams review PR5774 vs PR5776 and weigh in on bid gossip approach within a few days
Bring FOCIL payload rebuild ambiguity to next ACDE for EL team input
PQ deposit contract designers must explicitly address deposit front-running; core devs confirm this is a requirement

decisions.decision: SFI for Hegota: EIP-8015 (beacon state cleanup)
EIP-8365 decision deferred two weeks; to be discussed at DevCon and resolved next call
CFI for Hegota: EIP-8334 (Bundled Attestation Propagation), EIP-8383 (Reduce CL Block Retention Window), EIP-8148 (Custom sweep threshold), EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast)
DFI: EIP-8205 (deposit front-running fix); problem acknowledged, fix committed to PQ deposit contract redesign
Ben Edgington named lead ACDC moderator, Will Kokorin as deputy, effective next call (two weeks)

targets.target: Glamsterdam devnet with Lido PR — estimated November 16–20, 2026
